event.name: GitHub Universe 2026
event.venue: Fort Mason Center, 2 Marina Blvd, San Francisco, CA 94123

sessions.title: Opening Keynote
sessions.description: GitHub's next era of software, with announcements, live demos, tools, and workflows.

sessions.title: Agentic engineering past the pilot: An enterprise playbook
sessions.description: Enterprise patterns for moving agentic engineering from experiments to an operating model.

sessions.title: How one open source project turned funding into security at scale
sessions.description: How the Secure Open Source Fund and ScanAPI converted funding, education, and Copilot into security outcomes.
sessions.room: BATS Theatre @ Fort Mason Building B, 3rd Floor

sessions.title: Securing MCP: Real exploits, what actually mitigates them, and what doesn't
sessions.description: An interactive examination of MCP exploits, effective mitigations, production hosting, and remaining gaps.

sessions.title: Shut the context window! You're letting the tokens out
sessions.description: How Copilot constructs context and how to reduce token bloat with focused workflows and guardrails.

sessions.title: Your benchmark is lying: What evals actually look like
sessions.description: GitHub Copilot's production evaluation methods and a framework for creating outcome-oriented evals.
sessions.room: Sandbox @ Fort Mason Building C, Founders Inc., 3rd Floor

sessions.title: Stop malicious packages before they reach your build with GitHub Package Firewall
sessions.description: A demonstration of screening upstream dependencies before malicious packages execute in CI/CD runners.

sessions.title: Building AI fluency at UPS
sessions.description: UPS's progression from Copilot awareness to agent fluency, including motivation, measurement, and SDLC bottlenecks.

sessions.title: Four primitives to evaluate and improve your on-call agent's autonomy
sessions.description: A model for on-call autonomy through triage, investigation, action, and learning.

sessions.title: How GitHub taught Copilot to remember and when to forget
sessions.description: Research showing accumulated context can hurt agents, plus Skill Forge and Copilot REM selective-memory approaches.
sessions.room: BATS Theatre @ Fort Mason Building B, 3rd Floor

sessions.title: I made my Octolamp think with GitHub Copilot CLI hooks
sessions.description: Copilot CLI lifecycle hooks and WLED make an Octolamp display agent working, idle, and error states.

sessions.title: Real ways we cut token costs without slowing developers
sessions.description: Practical reductions for bloated prompts, repeated context, and noisy CI workflows.
sessions.room: Sandbox @ Fort Mason Building C, Founders Inc., 3rd Floor

sessions.title: Agentic modernization of .NET and Java apps with GitHub Copilot
sessions.description: A playbook for analyzing, upgrading, securing, testing, and migrating .NET and Java applications.

sessions.title: Resolve your security alerts faster with GitHub Copilot
sessions.description: A live demonstration of agentic autofix producing mergeable fixes for security-alert backlogs.

sessions.title: AI, Actions, and tooling: Coinbase's move to GitHub with data residency
sessions.description: Coinbase's migration of more than 10,000 repositories using Actions and an AI agent while maintaining regulated-data compliance.

sessions.title: People, process, and GitHub: Eliminating 90% of enterprise AppSec risk
sessions.description: Manulife's communication, reporting, and GitHub-native controls for remediating more than 90% of its vulnerability backlog.

venueTips.title: Start at Fort Mason Center
venueTips.detail: GitHub Universe 2026 is at Fort Mason Center, 2 Marina Blvd, San Francisco.

venueTips.title: Leave time between buildings
venueTips.detail: Sessions span Festival Pavilion, Gateway Pavilion, Buildings B and C, and the Firehouse. Keep transfer time in the itinerary.

venueTips.title: Recheck the public catalog
venueTips.detail: Published times and rooms can change. Refresh the live catalog before relying on the plan onsite.
